project.name: mpips
project.description: Reusable Madeena image-processing execution microservice for DAG-based scientific image processing.
project.service_boundary: MPIPS executes image-processing DAGs for Madeena clients. It owns FastAPI job/catalog endpoints, Celery execution, image node implementations, S3-compatible object storage IO, Redis-backed job state, IQA metadata, and signed webhook callbacks. Calling applications own users, visual builders, billing, user-facing image serving, and business metadata.

backend.package_manager: uv lockfile present; standard pip editable install supported

frontend.type: static dashboard assets mounted by FastAPI

database.runtime_state: Redis stores Celery state and mpips:job:* status snapshots
database.object_storage: S3-compatible storage via boto3, including MinIO-compatible AWS_ENDPOINT_URL

infrastructure.container: Dockerfile based on python:3.12-slim with API and worker roles
infrastructure.deployment_constraint: Use CI/CD or committed configuration only; direct SSH is prohibited

modules.app/main.py: FastAPI application factory, branded docs, root, health, secure-test, static dashboard mount, API router inclusion.
modules.app/api/v1/router.py: Versioned node catalog and job lifecycle routes.
modules.app/api/v1/health.py: Health checks for uptime, Redis connectivity, Celery worker availability, and environment.
modules.app/core/dag.py: Topological sort and DAG execution engine with temp file cleanup, S3/URL IO, output metadata, and IQA metrics.
modules.app/core/security.py: HTTP Bearer auth, developer bypass, JWKS key resolution, JWT verification, and scope checks.
modules.app/core/storage.py: S3-compatible and presigned URL download/upload helpers.
modules.app/core/tenant_paths.py: Tenant prefix validation for input and output storage paths.
modules.app/schemas: Pydantic request/response and node catalog schemas.
modules.celery_tasks: Celery app configuration, run_pipeline task, Redis state updates, webhook dispatch, cancellation behavior.
modules.image_engine: Image processing node implementations, node factory, and IQA helpers.
modules.mpips: Installable package exports, ASGI entrypoint, CLI entrypoints, and public engine imports.
modules.tests: Pytest suite for API, Celery/webhooks, DAG, image nodes, scientific nodes, security, storage, package imports, and root endpoint.
modules.camera-callibration-dotgrid: Bundled calibration research/prototype artifacts, data, references, outputs, and scripts; not part of packaged MPIPS service.
modules.imager-pipeline: Bundled legacy/prototype image pipeline scripts; not part of packaged MPIPS service.
